content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the SVNIT Registrar Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 19-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of SVNIT to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SVNIT Registrar post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the SVNIT Registrar post is 19 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Registrar position?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification for the Registrar post is a Master's degree with at least 55% Marks or its equivalent grade ‘B' in the UGC 7 point scale from a recognized University/Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Registrar post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Registrar post is 58 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India norms for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the SVNIT Registrar recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official website of SVNIT. The application process involves filling out the form, uploading documents, and paying the application fee if applicable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the SVNIT Registrar post?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs.1000 for Other Applicants. SC, ST, PwD, and Female candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Registrar position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be appointed at Pay Level 14 with a Grade Pay of Rs.10000/-, which corresponds to a salary of Rs.37400-67000.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of selection for the Registrar post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Registrar post will primarily involve an Interview. An Objective/Skill Test/Presentation may also be conducted if deemed necessary.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any experience required for the Registrar post?
faq.answer: Yes, significant administrative and educational experience is required, as detailed in the eligibility criteria section of this article and the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Gujarat apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from all over India are eligible to apply, provided they meet the specified educational and experience criteria. The institute is located in Surat, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
